task.title:house: Ready a room for a householder
task.how:wood: Hold left-click on a tree trunk until it breaks. Four logs of any tree.
task.how:bench: Press E. Turn a log into planks, then set four planks in a square.
task.how:woodpick: Place the workbench and right-click it. Three planks over two sticks. The recipe book can lay out the grid.
task.how:stonepick: Dig down with the wooden pick until it brings up rubble. Three rubble over two sticks, at the workbench.
task.how:torch: Coal over a stick, by hand. Coal Ore is stone with black flecks. Tama come up at night wherever it is dark.
task.how:furnace: Eight rubble in a ring at the workbench. Fed with wood or coal, it smelts soft ore and cooks meat.
task.how:iron: Iron Ore has tan flecks and needs a stone pick. Smelt it in the Stone Furnace with coal or wood. Three bars.
task.how:anvil: Seven iron bars at the workbench. Metal tools, weapons and armour are made on it.
task.how:ironpick: At the anvil. It breaks Gold Ore, Geodes and Hīrak Ore.
task.how:house: Close in a room with a door and a torch, then place a Holder's Bed in it: hide over planks. A householder will come to it.
task.how:idol: A log, 2 plant fiber, 2 jelly from Kinva and a red flower, at the workbench. The chest of a Broken Store may hold one.
task.how:boss1: Lay the likeness on a Vanahar Altar. It slams the ground round it and charges. Paroha come at half strength. Bring food and salves.
task.how:tinker: Vanahar Remains between two iron bars, over planks, at the workbench. It joins two trinkets into one.
task.how:lumenite: Hīrak Ore glows blue in the deep rock, under height 34. An iron pick or better. Three gems.
task.how:lumpick: At the anvil. It breaks Jalit Ore and Black Glass.
task.how:lure: 2 sandstone, a gold bar, raw meat and ember dust, at the workbench. Angār drop the dust: on sand at night, and by lava.
task.how:boss2: Lay the lure on a Maruhar Altar. It travels under whoever it hunts and comes up beneath them, so keep moving. Kīta come later.
task.how:emberforge: Maruhar Remains ringed by eight Deep Rock, at the workbench. It smelts Jalit Ore, the glowing orange ore near lava.
task.how:cinder: Jalit Ore lies by lava under height 26 and needs a Hīrak Pick. Five bars from the Maruhar Furnace. A set of Jalit armour helps.
task.how:bell: 2 iron bars, a Hīrak, 2 shade flesh and 2 bone, at the anvil. The chest of a Sealed Store may hold one.
task.how:boss3: Lay the bell on a Kankāl Altar. Its pale orbs come slowly, in fans and rings: step sideways between them. Tama come near the end.
task.how:gate1: Black Glass rims lava under height 12 and needs a Hīrak Pick. Seven of it round Kankāl Remains at the anvil. Then place the gate.
task.how:dim1: Step into the gate and stand still until it carries you through. A bedroll in the Hollow marks nothing.
task.how:umbrite: Antar Ore is violet, in Hollow Rock, and needs a Jalit Pick. Smelt five bars in the Maruhar Furnace.
task.how:censer: 2 Antar bars, 3 spore sacs and a Glowing Mushroom, at the anvil. The chest of a Vault in the Hollow may hold one.
task.how:boss4: In the Hollow, lay the smoker on the Guhamāt Altar. It drops spore on marked ground, and Kavak form where it lands. Kill each as it forms.
task.how:voidkiln: Guhamāt Remains ringed by eight Hollow Rock, at the workbench. It smelts Tala Ore, the teal ore of the Hollow, and Ākās Ore.
task.how:noctrium: Tala Ore lies in the lower half of the Hollow and needs an Antar Pick. Five bars from the Guhamāt Furnace.
task.how:kite: 2 crystal fiber, 3 feathers, a Tala bar and moth dust, at the workbench. Salaha in the Hollow drop the dust.
task.how:boss5: Jīmūt comes to the kite laid on a Jīmūt Altar on the living ground. It circles and stoops and never lands: bring a bow or a staff.
task.how:gate2: Six Tala bars round Jīmūt Remains, at the anvil. Place it as you placed the first.
task.how:dim2: Step into the gate. There is nothing under the edges. A fall from one puts you back on the last footing, hurt.
task.how:aether: Ākās Ore is blue, in Island Rock, and needs a Tala Pick. Smelt five bars in the Guhamāt Furnace.
task.how:lens: 2 Ākās bars, 3 shards from Sakal and a pane of glass, at the anvil. The chest of an Island Store may hold one.
task.how:boss6: Lay the lens on a Ratan Altar on the Islands. Its beam swings slowly after you: cross it at a run. Sakal come near the end.
task.how:crucible: At the workbench, ring Ratan Remains with eight Island Rock. It smelts Patik Ore.
task.how:prism: Patik Ore is pink, in Island Rock, and needs an Ākās Pick. Five bars from the Ratan Furnace.
task.how:slivers: On the eighth night of the moon's round the moon is dark, and Chandasāvak and Ulūk come up. They drop Moon Slivers. Three are needed.
task.how:mask: 2 Patik bars, 3 Moon Slivers and 2 shade flesh, at the Line Frame.
task.how:boss7: Only after dark: lay the mask on a Kuranga Altar. It charges and slams, and Chandasāvak come partway through.
task.how:eclforge: Eight Black Glass round Kuranga Remains, at the workbench. It smelts Gahan Ore.
task.how:eclipse: Gahan Ore glows violet on the bedrock, under height 14, and needs a Patik Pick. Three bars from the Kuranga Furnace.
task.how:key: 3 Gahan bars, a Hīrak Block, 2 Moon Slivers and 2 shards, at the anvil.
task.how:boss8: Lay the key on the Cairn. It throws glowing stones, slams, turns a beam and moves from place to place. Chandasāvak come near the end.
task.how:end: The crew holds Nihān Remains, the strongest kill there is. No step of the Guide uses them.
task.said:house: Put a holder's bed in a closed room with a door and a light, and one of us will come and hold there.
task.said:idol: Carve a likeness from a log, bind Kinva jelly to it and put a red flower on it. Vanahar comes to that.
task.said:boss1: Lay the likeness at the nearest Vanahar altar and wake it. Bring the remains back, peopl. Kāru and Vejja will come for them.
task.said:tinker: Set the Vanahar remains in a bench between two iron bars. Two worked pieces can be joined into one on it.
task.said:lumenite: Go down past the iron into the deep rock. The blue gem there takes an edge that will cut the next rock.
task.said:lumpick: A pick of the blue gem breaks the warm orange ore by the molten rock, and the black glass round it.
task.said:lure: Sink a gold bar in sandstone with raw meat and ember dust. Maruhar comes up through the sand for that.
task.said:boss2: Call Maruhar up with the lure. Its remains make a furnace that works what fire leaves hard, and Kammār will have more to sell.
task.said:emberforge: Ring the Maruhar remains with deep rock and put fire to them. That works the warm ore, and later the metal of Under.
task.said:cinder: Work the warm ore in the Maruhar furnace. Its bars make a pick for the ore of Under.
task.said:bell: Cast an iron bell with the blue gem in its wall, and pack it with shade flesh and bone. Kankāl answers it.
task.said:boss3: Ring the bell at a Kankāl altar. Its remains open the way Under. Posak will come to you then, and Vejja will have more.
task.said:gate1: Frame the Kankāl remains in black glass. Wherever the frame will stand, it opens on Under.
task.said:dim1: Go through and bring back the metals of Under. None of us will follow you there, peopl.
task.said:umbrite: The violet ore of Under works in the Maruhar furnace. Take a pick of it to the lower metal.
task.said:censer: Fill a smoker of the violet metal with spore sacs and a glowing cap. The smoke brings Guhamāt to it.
task.said:boss4: Burn the smoker at the Guhamāt altar Under. Its remains make a furnace for the lower metal, and Kammār will sell the violet.
task.said:voidkiln: The Guhamāt remains go in a ring of the rock of Under. The furnace works the teal metal, and later the metal past the second gate.
task.said:noctrium: The teal metal lies low, Under. Its bars make the frame of a second gate.
task.said:kite: Make a kite of crystal thread, feathers, a teal bar and moth dust, and fly it from a Jīmūt altar.
task.said:boss5: Fly the kite and bring Jīmūt down to the altar. Its remains make the second gate.
task.said:gate2: Set the Jīmūt remains in a frame of teal bars. None of us has a word for where that gate leads.
task.said:dim2: Go through the second gate. The metal past it is harder than any you have worked yet.
task.said:aether: Bring back the blue metal from past the second gate. The metal with crystal in it yields to a pick of that.
task.said:lens: Grind a lens of glass in a rim of the blue metal and set shards in it. It gathers light, and the light calls Ratan.
task.said:boss6: Focus the lens at the Ratan altar past the second gate. Ratan's remains are what the next furnace needs.
task.said:crucible: For the metal with crystal in it, set the Ratan remains in rock from past the second gate.
task.said:prism: Work that pink metal into bars. A pick of it breaks the violet ore at the very bottom of the rock.
task.said:slivers: On Amāvassa the moon is hollow, and what was in it walks the ground. Bring back three of the slivers it drops.
task.said:mask: Make the mask of the pink metal, with moon slivers and shade flesh. Kuranga sees whoever wears it, at night.
task.said:boss7: Wear the mask at a Kuranga altar after dark, and bring its remains for the last furnace.
task.said:eclforge: Black glass round the Kuranga remains makes the furnace for the violet ore at the bottom of the rock.
task.said:eclipse: Bring up three bars of the last metal. The key to the cairn is made of them.
task.said:key: Forge the key of the last metal, with a block of the blue gem, moon slivers and shards. It opens the cairn.
task.said:boss8: Open the cairn with the key. The forebears closed their first stone under it. With Nihān dead, the stones can be lit again.
task.said:end: A stone is lit only while one of us sits at it with a hand on it. None of us has sat at a great one yet.

realm:enter.1: No sky overhead. What light there is comes off the growth.
country.enter:ocean: Still water lying at one height. Nothing in it flows.
country.enter:beach: A strip of sand between the grass and the water.
country.enter:plains: Open grass grazed short, with a lone oak here and there.
country.enter:palewood: Pale-barked trees over grass and flowers, with young oaks among them.
country.enter:forest: Old oaks stand close over fern and mushroom.
country.enter:bloomvale: Trees in blossom over pale turf thick with white and blue flowers.
country.enter:swamp: Mud barely over the water, with reeds and low broad oaks in a haze.
country.enter:taiga: Cold pine wood with fern and berry under it. Snow on the high ground.
country.enter:tundra: Flat white country: snow on the grass, ice along the water.
country.enter:desert: Dunes of hot sand. Cactus and dry bramble grow on them.
country.enter:savanna: Tall dry grass. Flat-topped trees stand far apart.
country.enter:jungle: Hot wet wood. The trunks go up past any oak, over fern.
country.enter:crags: High stone. Grass on the flats, bare rock on the slopes.
country.enter:peaks: Snow over stone. Nothing grows here.
country.enter:hollows: Fungal turf underfoot, glowing growth, and stems with caps overhead.
country.enter:hollows_crystal: Bare rock set with spires of azure and violet crystal.
country.enter:rift: Turf and white and blue flowers, under trees whose leaves give light.
country.enter:rift_shards: Islands set with spires of pale crystal, and white flowers between.
